data.title: Bitcoin dips to $74k as regulatory uncertainty, ETF outflows weigh
data.description: Investing.com-- Bitcoin dipped on Monday, extending a steep downturn from last week as a souring regulatory outlook for U.S. markets, following a Democratic sweep of Congress, dampened appetite for cryptocurrencies.
